nodes.label: ADR-001: Migrate pytbak from Flask to FastAPI
nodes.author: Lorenzo Girardi
nodes.norm_label: adr-001: migrate pytbak from flask to fastapi

nodes.label: Dev vs Prod backend wiring
nodes.rationale: In development PG and Redis run in docker-compose; in production they are external HTTP/S endpoints via env vars, and if missing the app falls back to in-memory storage.

nodes.label: Graceful fallback chain: PG -> Redis -> In-Memory
nodes.norm_label: graceful fallback chain: pg -> redis -> in-memory
nodes.rationale: All backends are optional; the app starts and works with zero external deps, so PG/Redis outages degrade gracefully instead of breaking the app.

nodes.label: Why AI Review Sweep uses schedule instead of pull_request_target
nodes.norm_label: why ai review sweep uses schedule instead of pull_request_target
nodes.rationale: A schedule run has no PR actor and no fork, so it gets the repo's full GITHUB_TOKEN; GitHub caps GITHUB_TOKEN to read-only on pull_request runs authored by a bot, which blocks merging. A sweep also retroactively covers PRs opened before the workflow existed.

nodes.label: Why PR Checks exists as a deterministic pre-merge gate
nodes.norm_label: why pr checks exists as a deterministic pre-merge gate
nodes.rationale: pipeline.yml only ran on push to main, so nothing was built/tested on a PR before merge. Two auto-merged dependency bumps broke main in one morning (Python 3.12->3.14 unsolvable pip install; fastapi 0.115->0.141 causing 500s) — both are things a deterministic command proves in seconds while an LLM diff review can only guess at.

nodes.label: Middleware-based debug features (error/delay injection)
nodes.rationale: Implementing error injection (?inject_error=) and delay (?delay_ms=) as middleware makes them work on ANY endpoint without per-route code.

nodes.label: Why AI Review Sweep's required_checks must match pr-checks.yml job names
nodes.norm_label: why ai review sweep's required_checks must match pr-checks.yml job names
nodes.rationale: Without naming the exact job names, the gate only asks that nothing failed, and a Renovate PR whose sole check is ai-review.yml reporting 'skipped' (it skips bot authors) would satisfy that — which is exactly how PRs #91 and #92 got merged with nothing tested.

nodes.label: Single create_app() factory pattern
nodes.rationale: A single app factory in app/main.py is used for testability.
